name: Shade Carrier
method: Direct visual review of four references; file validation separate from vehicle construction approval.
confirmed: Six-wheel design: three near-side wheels visible in each profile, front/back show three per side.
Rear closed cargo doors differ from smashed cab/front jaw.
Dark iron freight body violet shadow windows and energy seams retained.
limitations: Front headlights are painted facing camera in side views, inconsistent with forward-facing mounts.
Side exhaust placement includes rear stack unlike front pair near cab; establish fixed locations.
Front/rear views retain perspective with visible sidewalls; not strict orthographic.
Jaw-door hinges and open angles require common construction map.
Wheel size, axle spacing and body length need normalized scale comparison.
Cargo panel seam patterns vary; preserve landmarks for animation.
Side bumpers have tight frame margins.
next: Resolve fixed six-wheel chassis dimensions, lamp/exhaust mounts and jaw hinges; separate wheels, body, doors and shadow layers for roll/attack/collapse animation.
